title: Deep Meets Classical: A CPU-Efficient Decision-Fusion Model for Automatic Modulation Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.05937v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic modulation classification (AMC) underpins spectrum sensing and non-cooperative signal identification in cognitive radio, yet the two standard CPU-feasible approaches to it, a compact convolutional neural network (CNN) on raw in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) samples and a classical higher-order-cumulant feature classifier, are rarely compared against each other conditioned on signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). We show that they are, in fact, complementary: the CNN is markedly more robust at low SNR, where hand-crafted statistics collapse toward chance, while the cumulant classifier is more accurate at high SNR, where higher-order statistics cleanly separate dense constellations. We exploit this complementarity with FuseAMC, a lightweight decision-fusion model that trains a logistic-regression meta-combiner over the concatenated class-posteriors of an approximately 198k-parameter residual CNN and a gradient-boosted-tree cumulant classif

translated_title: 深度与经典的结合：一种CPU高效的自动调制分类决策融合模型
translated_abstract: 自动调制分类（AMC）是认知无线电中频谱感知和非协作信号识别的基础技术，然而其两种标准的CPU可行方法——基于原始同相/正交（I/Q）样本的紧凑卷积神经网络（CNN）和经典的高阶累积量特征分类器——很少在信噪比（SNR）条件下被相互比较。我们证明这两种方法实际上是互补的：CNN在低信噪比下明显更加鲁棒，此时手工设计的统计特征已接近随机猜测水平；而累积量分类器在高信噪比下更加准确，此时高阶统计量能够清晰地区分密集星座。我们利用这种互补性提出了FuseAMC，这是一种轻量级的决策融合模型，它在约19.8万参数的残差CNN和梯度提升树累积量分类器的拼接类后验之上，训练一个逻辑回归元组合器。
tldr: 本文提出FuseAMC轻量级决策融合模型，利用CNN在低信噪比下更鲁棒、高阶累积量分类器在高信噪比下更准确的互补特性，通过逻辑回归元组合器融合两者输出，实现了CPU高效的自动调制分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FuseAMC, a lightweight decision-fusion model that exploits the complementarity between a compact CNN (robust at low SNR) and a higher-order-cumulant classifier (accurate at high SNR) via a logistic-regression meta-combiner, achieving CPU-efficient automatic modulation classification.
